[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
A saved Findmypast transcription of Kirknewton and East Calder OPR 690/3, item 2, page 45 records John Glasgow as born on 30 December 1797 to Wm Glasgow and Cath Neobet, with residence Meadbk.<ref>Findmypast, “Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929,” John Glasgow, OPR 690/3, item 2, page 45, transcript [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F4478189 SCOT/OPR/BAP/4478189]; derivative transcription, original register page not yet inspected.</ref> The existing baptism citation gives 13 January 1798 and names William Glasgow and Catharine Nisbet.<ref>Baptism Index Scotlands People Old Parish Registers Kirknewton and East Calder Midlothian 1798  John Glasgow baptized 13 Jan 1798 at  child of William Glasgow and  Catharine Nisbet  - 690/30 124 - </ref> These entries probably concern the same child, but their page references and the maternal spelling need comparison with the original register. The recorded father and mother are compared with [[Glasgow-1223|William Glasgow]] and [[Nisbet-3257|Catherine Nisbet]]; identification with the adult profiles is a separate assessment, and the father’s childhood-to-adult bridge remains unproved.


John Glasgow

    Record Type: Deaths & Burials
    Data Set: Calton Burials Index
    Buried: 24 March 1821
    Location: Britain & Ireland, Calton, Glasgow, Scotland
    Surnames: Glasgow

Aged: 22m: Cause of Death: water in the head.

This Calton burial entry remains on the profile as a lead, but an age of 22 months in March 1821 is incompatible with a December 1797 birth. It cannot currently be assigned to this John.

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1223]] is assessed at 87% (probable). The saved Findmypast derivative transcript names Wm Glasgow and Cath Neobet and gives John’s birth as 30 December 1797 at Meadbk; the held Kirknewton/East Calder baptism account reports 13 January 1798 and names William Glasgow and Catherine/Catharine Nisbet. The dates fit birth followed by baptism, but the original register should resolve page and surname differences. Repeated paired parents strongly identify the adult family, but William’s 1765 Swinton childhood lacks a direct adult bridge.

Selected father-profile identity and paternal relationship; maternal identity is separate.

Next useful test: Compare the original OPR 690/3 item 2 page 45 with the held 690/30 page 124 baptism citation, and read the parents’ marriage for William’s origin.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-1326 Baptism Index Scotlands People Old Parish Registers Kirknewton and East Calder Midlothian 1798 John Glasgow baptized 13 Jan 1798 at child of William Glasgow and Catharine Nisbet - 690/30 124 -]. No new father attached; the Findmypast entry is a saved derivative transcript, not an inspected original register.
